title: Can Postoperative Outcomes be Predicted From Asking OSA Screening Questions Pre-operatively?
brief_summary: The proposed research will determine whether a 6-item screening questionnaire previously shown to correlate with moderate or severe OSA is useful for predicting postoperative outcomes in children undergoing surgery under general anesthesia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* The study will include all who are presenting for surgery to the main operating room, ambulatory surgical center or procedure center at Nationwide Children's Hospital.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Emergency surgery and any caregiver or patient refusal.
study_population: Children having surgery at Nationwide Children's Hosp (NCH).
